verdict.rationale: Langfuse's docs explicitly document LLM-as-a-Judge evaluators that produce numeric, categorical, or boolean scores, can run automatically on live production traces, and can be configured against datasets/experiments; this is a first-party, dedicated feature rather than a workaround. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of configuring custom judge prompts or judge model selection, and no community evidence specifically validating LLM-as-a-judge quality in practice.
